headline: Core FFO grows y/y with strong rent gains and full leasing
summary_short: Prologis' Q3 2026 core FFO was $1.60 per share (+7% y/y) on revenues of $2.39B (+8%); net earnings per share were $0.86 and average occupancy 95.4%.
summary_long: Rental and other revenue rose to $2.22B and strategic capital revenue to $164M. Net effective rent change on leases commenced was 38.0% on Prologis share, and same-store cash NOI rose 5.9%. Development stabilizations and starts continued, with a $39.7B build-out potential on land and 5.8GW of data center power pipeline. Debt was $36.8B. Full-year 2026 guidance is core FFO of $6.25-$6.29 per share, average occupancy of 95.25%-95.50% and cash same-store NOI growth of 7.0%-7.5%.
confidence_notes: The exhibit is the Q3 supplemental package, not a narrative press release; no management commentary was available, so drivers are limited to arithmetic from the tables. Core FFO and same-store NOI are the company's non-GAAP measures. Revenue and EBITDA growth computed from the three-month columns.

drivers.explanation: Real estate core FFO rose to $1.54 per share from $1.43 and strategic capital stayed at $0.06, per the business-line breakdown.
Rental and other revenues rose from $2,064M to $2,224M and strategic capital revenues from $150M to $164M.
